usedFor: Applivery distributes mobile app builds, and Dropbox keeps the files. A “New Build Processed” in Applivery can run “Upload File to Dropbox” to save a file from a public link into a chosen folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Build Processed” in Applivery, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Processed means the build is ready to install, so the file you save is the final one. “New Build Uploaded” fires earlier, before processing is done.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” pulls from a public web link, so the build must be reachable at one. You also choose how an existing file is handled: add, replace or update.
